What is Texas Tech Online+ (TTU Online+)?

TTU Online+ is a fully online, student-centered learning model at Texas Tech University designed with structured support, 8-week courses, and dedicated staff to help students succeed from start to finish.

Can I take online and on-campus classes at the same time?

TTU Online only offers asynchronous 8-week online courses. There are some programs traditional programs through TTU Lubbock that have both on-campus and online course options.

Does the online degree program allow for hybrid classes?

All TTU Online programs are fully asynchronous online. However there are some hybrid degree options through TTU Lubbock.

Can you tell me more about your online programs?

TTU Online offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate degrees designed for flexibility, accessibility, and career alignment, delivered in accelerated 8-week formats. We have programs in the social sciences, pre-health, business, leadership, communication, etc.

Is TTU Online accredited?

Yes, Texas Tech University is accredited by Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges.

Would Online+ be better for me since I work full time and I cannot attend class in person? Can I take all my classes online from the beginning of college?

The Texas Tech Online+ program is designed specifically for working professionals, providing the flexibility to complete your coursework fully online. This makes it an excellent choice for individuals who work full-time and cannot attend classes in person. You can take all your classes online from the beginning of your studies, as the program offers various online degree options that can accommodate your schedule. If you're interested in learning more or getting started with the Online+ program, please visit http://GoOnline.ttu.edu (opens in new tab) or contact them directly at 1-844-691-0494 or online@ttu.edu.

What is the common misunderstanding about the online degree program at TTU?

A common misconception is that online degrees are less rigorous; in reality, they are taught by the same faculty and meet the same academic standards as on-campus programs.

Would Online+ be a good fit for a student that was not yet mature enough to go to college earlier in life but is now ready to commit to education?

Yes, the Online+ program at Texas Tech University would be a great fit for a student who may not have been ready for college earlier in life but is now committed to pursuing their education. The program is designed specifically for non-traditional students, including those looking to balance their studies with work and life commitments. It offers flexibility with eight-week accelerated courses and asynchronous learning, allowing students to study on their own schedule. Additionally, the program recognizes prior work-life experiences, making it easier for students to earn credit and complete their degree. If you're interested in getting started or want more information, you can visit http://GoOnline.ttu.edu (opens in new tab) or contact the TTU Online+ program at 1-844-691-0494 or online@ttu.edu.

Would Online+ be a good fit for someone that did not finish high school but got their GED?

Online+ may be an option if you have obtained a GED. We require an official high school transcript for any high school coursework completed before obtaining your GED. Official transcripts must be sent directly from the high school to Texas Tech University to Admissions.Transcripts@ttu.edu if sent electronically. If sent from the high school by mail, it must be in the original sealed envelope and sent directly to TTUO Admissions, 4201 State Hwy 161 Suite 250, Irving, TX 75038. *We cannot accept transcripts that are emailed or uploaded by students. Transcripts may take several business days to be downloaded, received, and processed by Texas Tech University. GED scores can be emailed to the student’s Enrollment Service Specialist for the application.

I would love to know more about the TTU Online+ program itself.

Online+ is designed to remove barriers for working adults and nontraditional students by combining flexibility with high-touch support and predictable scheduling.

Are all of the online programs at TTU 8 weeks long?

No, Online+ programs use 8-week terms, while some traditional programs may still follow 16-week formats.

Are courses for the TTU Online+ programs completely asynchronous?

Yes, all Online+ courses are designed to be flexible and asynchronous.

**Texas Tech Online+ (TTU Online+) Overview**

- **Fully Online Learning Model**: TTU Online+ is a fully online, student-centered learning model at Texas Tech University. It provides structured support with 8-week courses and dedicated staff to help students succeed from start to finish.

- **Flexibility and Accessibility**: The program offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate degrees that are flexible and accessible, delivered in accelerated 8-week formats. This is ideal for working professionals and non-traditional students who need to balance education with other commitments.

- **Asynchronous Courses**: All courses in the TTU Online+ program are asynchronous, meaning there are no required live sessions, allowing students to complete coursework on their own schedule.

- **Accreditation**: Texas Tech University, including its online programs, is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges.

- **Support for Non-Traditional Students**: The program is specifically designed to accommodate non-traditional students, including those who work full-time or have other life commitments. It also recognizes prior work-life experiences, making it easier for students to earn credit and complete their degree.

- **Contact Information**: For more information or to get started with the Online+ program, you can visit [GoOnline.ttu.edu](http://GoOnline.ttu.edu), call 1-844-691-0494, or email online@ttu.edu.
